project_info.theme: ShopeeVIP UPRIZE fan meeting event poster
project_info.color_palette: Stage red, bright blue, gold, white, orange

main_subject.detail: A vivid red-curtain event poster for ShopeeVIP and UPRIZE. A large blue marquee sign says 'GAP GO NHOM UPRIZE & NHAN QUA TU SHOPEEVIP'. In the middle is a tilted polaroid-style group photo of UPRIZE members with the Shopee crown mascot; the lower part of the polaroid reads 'FM | 12.7.01 MHZ' with small labels like 'PN', 'LAVM', 'O.D', 'WONBI', 'DYLAN', 'LEON', 'BEX'. Another strip across the photo says 'TAI BOOTH TRAI NGHIEM FAN MEETING'. A blue date card reads 'tu 8H30-18H NGAY 17.7.2026'. The bottom reward block lists 'ALBUM THANG', 'GOI SHOPEEVIP 12 THANG MIEN PHI', 'CARD BO GOC', and 'VOUCHER GIAM 30%'. The right-side schedule says '8H30 - 18H00 CHECK-IN VA BOC THAM TRUNG THUONG' and '15H30 - 15H50 MEET & GREET UPRIZE'.
main_subject.style: Concert-style event poster with red stage curtains, group-photo centerpiece, marquee signage, and detailed schedule blocks

Surrounding elements: Shopee and ShopeeVIP logos, giant blue sign 'GAP GO NHOM UPRIZE & NHAN QUA TU SHOPEEVIP', strip 'TAI BOOTH TRAI NGHIEM FAN MEETING', date card 'tu 8H30-18H NGAY 17.7.2026', reward tiles 'ALBUM THANG', 'GOI SHOPEEVIP 12 THANG MIEN PHI', 'CARD BO GOC', 'VOUCHER GIAM 30%', and the schedule text '8H30 - 18H00 CHECK-IN VA BOC THAM TRUNG THUONG' plus '15H30 - 15H50 MEET & GREET UPRIZE'.
